quotes.author: mel
quotes.text: I had a really great experience on this tour. Kevin communicated with us in both Mandarin and English and was extremely knowledgeable about the canyons we visited. He was also very friendly and accommodating throughout the trip, always making sure everyone was comfortable and was happy to answer any questions. The itinerary was well planned and his directions were easy to follow. Harry, our bus driver, was also very nice and helped make the long drives feel safe and comfortable. Overall, it was a really enjoyable tour and I would definitely recommend it.

quotes.author: Diego
quotes.text: Seven days connecting southern France and Barcelona, moving to a new place every day with scenic drives along the way—the pace wasnt slow, but it worked. My favorites were the Palais des Papes and Pont Saint-Benezet in Avignon, and Sagrada Familia in Barcelona; Gaudís architecture really left an impression. Breakfast was included, lunches and dinners were on our own, which felt reasonable overall.

quotes.author: Merlin
quotes.text: This tour linked several national parks well. We spent a fair amount of time on the coach, but each stop allowed about an hour to stretch and take photos. Antelope Canyon was optional at $105 per adult; since I was there anyway, I thought it was worth joining.

quotes.author: Christena
quotes.text: Six days covered the major cities in the eastern US and Canada—a packed but well-organized route. My favorite part was the Niagara Falls night tour; the illuminated water was spectacular. It was a mandatory add-on at $45 per adult, but I felt it was worth it.

quotes.author: Subhendu
quotes.text: The tour was excellent. The tour guide was very cooperative and friendly. He took all efforts to make the tour a memorable. We could see the hidden treasuries of American national parks. My score for the trip as well as Guide is 10 out of 10.

quotes.author: Lucas
quotes.text: Seven days across five countries felt packed, but every day had something memorable. Cologne Cathedral and the Louvre stood out most to me. I had to book the Louvre ticket online myself in advance, which worked out fine since I planned ahead.
